classification.rationale: Comprehensive search across Tier 1-3 sources yielded zero evidence of CDM adoption, FINOS membership, or ISDA working group participation. ICBC is the world's largest bank by assets (~$6.3 trillion USD) with significant derivatives operations, but operates primarily within Chinese regulatory framework (CBIRC/PBOC) which does not mandate CDM. Lack of evidence reflects both genuine non-adoption and disclosure gap between Chinese and Western banking systems. 30% confidence reflects high certainty of null results but acknowledges possible internal initiatives not disclosed publicly.
